title: AnyImage
description:
AnyImage is vst instrument plug-in that produces no sound but allows loading any supported image to the vst host whenever there is a need for instant image support. For example, users can load photos of their notation sheet or guitar tabs into AnyImage's 16 slots and switch them or control them with their MIDI hardware equipment. They can also save their created image albums to a preset file and switch instantly between images by using their MIDI hardware.

 ##Features: 

16 slots for any supported images (bmp, jpeg, tiff, png) 
Midi assignable zoom knob
Midi assignable image switching menu
Midi assignable x,y knobs for image scrolling
Preset manager for instant album loading\saving
Midi automation manager
Resizable GUI

Imports images from the internet in a parallel channel by pasting an image link
Saves internet links with the presets

​`​Demo limitation: Only 2 of the 16 images slots is active. Presets saving\loading is not allowed.
